messages.author: a2b50625ea842397
messages.subject: Shiny Ui does not Reload
parts:
Helo

I try to run this shiny app on my computer : https://github.com/mostly-harmless/radiant
the problem is when i reload the browser the ui does not reload.

if i restart the R session, everything is loading properly.
but if refresh the browser the ui will not reload anymore.

the warning message in R console are as follows:
Warning in addResourcePath("figures", "tools/help/figures/") :
  Overriding existing prefix figures => C:\Users\Asus\Documents\R\shiny\fastedit\tools\help\figures\
Shiny URLs starting with /figures will mapped to C:\Users\Asus\Documents\R\shiny\radiant-master\inst\marketing\tools\help\figures\

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Ui does not Reload
parts:
I just noticed this problem. It happens in Shiny 9.1 and 10.0 but did not happen before. In Safari and Firefox the sidebarPanel and mainPanel are not shown at all in both 9.1 and 10.0. I am even getting this issue in .90. 

Interestingly the app works fine in all browsers when run from the server (http://vnijs.rady.ucsd.edu:3838/marketing/).

I don't have a solution for you at this time. I will see if the shiny developers have some ideas.
